scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Eco-certification of Coffee
other_conditions: Individual growers owning up to 10 hectares of coffee holdings are eligible
Groups of small growers (SHGs, collectives) are eligible
Non-tribal coffee growers in Non-Traditional Areas with holdings up to 10 hectares are eligible
Beneficiaries must obtain certification for sustainability or quality standards from accredited certification agencies
For organic certification, growers must be certified under the National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) or equivalent standards
A grower who has already received subsidy for the same activity/component during the MIDH period cannot apply again unless they are a new beneficiary
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 50% of certification costs (maximum ₹50,000), with an additional 10% (maximum ₹55,000) for SC/ST growers with holdings up to 4 hectares.
